title: December, 2012
logline: Does Chloe come home. She's in Portland. Wood drives the Legacy three hours to Portland. He gets as far as the Legacy allows.

panels.composition: Highway 18 inland, December, rain, the Legacy. WOOD driving. BARNABY on a blanket in the passenger seat. A sign: PORTLAND 71.

image.prompt: an old green Subaru wagon on an inland highway in December rain, a man driving, an old dog on a blanket in the passenger seat, a road sign reading PORTLAND 71, clean ink

panels.composition: The temperature gauge. Red. Steam from the hood, drawn exactly.

image.prompt: close-up of a dashboard temperature gauge in the red and steam rising from a car's hood, clean ink

panels.composition: The shoulder. The Legacy, hood up. Wood on the guardrail with the dog on his lap. Rain. A phone — a flip phone, his first, drawn small — at his ear.

characters.pose: on a guardrail with the dog, flip phone

balloons.text: Tuesday's. I know. I know it's Friday.
(phone) So forty from me. Sit tight.

image.prompt: a man sitting on a highway guardrail in the rain with an old dog on his lap and a flip phone at his ear, an old Subaru with its hood up beside him

panels.composition: Gully's flatbed arriving, the Legacy on its way up the ramp. Wood in the flatbed's cab with the dog. The sign in the rear window: PORTLAND 71, going away. The strip doesn't say what he'd have done at 0.

characters.pose: in the cab with the dog

image.prompt: a flatbed truck on a rainy highway shoulder winching up an old Subaru, a man and a dog in the cab, a road sign receding in the rear window, clean ink, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: He tries to drive to her. The Legacy decides. Gully at forty miles. The strip never says what he'd have done in Portland.
